messages:
sarah (support): FYI - ACME ticket #4567: customer reports p95 jump from ~120ms -> ~450ms around 2026-03-16 22:14 UTC. Dashboard panel shows big p95 spike but raw histogram scrape doesn't match. Screenshot: https://redir.example/shot.png

alex (oncall): can you paste the panel query + time range?

sarah (support): Panel name: "API latency p95 (prod)". Grafana query: `sum by (route)(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{env=\"prod\"}[5m])) by (le, route)))` - range 21:50-22:30 UTC per screenshot.

meera (eng-sre): quick question - did we push any telemetry changes earlier? I recall a metrics-agent rollout around 21:50 UTC.

alex (oncall): good call. Dan, any recent commits to the rollup/collector?

ops-bot: deploy - telemetry-agent v2.4.1 rolled out to prod at 2026-03-16T21:50:12Z (commit abc123).

dan (observability): commit abc123 changed histogram bucket config -> switched to exponential buckets (0.0001..5.0) instead of our previous linear 0..2s. That can skew quantiles if the query uses rollup aggregates.

josh (infra): also changed prometheus-rollup config at 21:55 to aggregate hourly -> 5m to reduce cardinality for a different dataset. Two changes touching histograms.

meera (eng-sre): ahhh — re-binning + rollup frequency change can cause `histogram_quantile` on aggregated series to miscompute quantiles if `le` buckets don't align. That would explain dashboard spike but raw scrape looks fine.

sarah (support): customer included a curl repro: `for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -w \"%{time_total}\n\" -o /dev/null -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate; sleep 0.01; done` - they said tail occasionally high but not consistent with dashboard p95.

alex (oncall): immediate mitigation: 1) roll back telemetry-agent bucket change in canary, 2) revert prometheus-rollup change to previous ref, 3) pin panel to raw metric (no rollup) and add annotation "telemetry rollout". Maya - can you tell customer we're investigating and ETA ~30-45m?

maya (customer success): on it. Messaging customer now: "We see a telemetry roll-out that may be causing your dashboard to show an inflated p95. We're reverting a recent change and will follow up in ~30m."

meera (eng-sre): repro steps for us: `curl -sS \"http://prod-metrics/export?route=/v1/generate&range=5m\" | jq .` then compute `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=\"/v1/generate\",env=\"prod\"}[5m])) by (le))` vs dashboard. I'll run now.

meera (eng-sre): quick run: dashboard panel p95=450ms, raw histogram calc p95=130ms. Confirms rollup/rewriting issue — rollup re-binned `le` labels.

alex (oncall): plan: a) revert prometheus-rollup commit (PR 789) b) pin Grafana panel to raw `request_duration_seconds_bucket` for last 24h c) fix rollup aggregator to preserve original `le` boundaries or encode bucket schema in label d) add alert when histogram_quantile vs raw diverges >20% e) create Jira for telemetry-agent bucket-change behind feature flag.

josh (infra): starting rollback of prometheus-rollup change on 3 rollup nodes now (started 2026-03-16T22:38:05Z).

ops-bot: revert-prometheus-rollup started by @josh at 2026-03-16T22:38:05Z (action id r-20260316-001).

josh (infra): rollback completed on node-1, node-2, node-3. Rollup now using previous linear buckets.

dan (observability): re-running query against panel target -> p95 sliding down to ~135ms in the 10m window. Looks like rollback fixed the artifact.

sarah (support): customer just replied: saw improvement, thank you. Will monitor for stability.

maya (customer success): sending update now: "We've reverted an internal telemetry change that caused dashboards to show inflated p95 values. No impact to actual API performance; monitoring is back to normal and engineering is hardening the telemetry pipeline."

meera (eng-sre): follow-ups: - add unit/regression tests for rollup aggregator & histograms - gate telemetry-agent bucket changes behind feature flag and staged rollout - add divergence alert + dashboard annotation automation - update runbook for histogram rollup incidents

alex (oncall): assigning follow-ups: meera -> tests & feature flag, dan -> update Grafana panels and add annotation, josh -> rollout gating for prometheus-rollup. I'll create Jira and link here (JIRA-RED-912).

meera (eng-sre): thanks, creating PRs today. Closing this thread once JIRA tasks are tracked. :thumbsup:

alex (oncall): good work team.
